learning_outcomes.text: have profound knowledge of basic principles of operation of electronic circuits
have knowledge and understanding of the behavior and of the main applications of basic electronic circuits
understand and explain the performances and characteristics of simple electronic circuits and systems
understand the fundamental concepts of electronic circuits and systems and their application to information and power management systems
demonstrate skill in circuit analysis and design
demonstrate capacity for understanding problems of information and power management and for addressing their solution by means of electronic circuits and systems

syllabus_topics: active loads and references: current mirror, active loads, amplifiers with current mirrors and active loads, voltage and current references, biasing of transistors

Operational amplifiers: Transconductance amplifier, internal structure and characteristics of an operational amplifier; real operational amplifier, applications (base circuits, active filters, impedance simulators, oscillators)
Analog circuits: Transistor-based multipliers, Gilbert cell, Phase-Locked Loop circuits, modulators, filters, noise analysis
Optical devices: Photodiodes, LED and laser diodes, solar cells
Active and passive filters: low-pass, high-pass and band-pass filters. Main types and design formulas
Analog/digital circuits and systems: Practical realization of logic ports; A/D and D/A converters; microcontroller systems; internal structure of a microcontroller
Examples of applications to microcontroller systems
Software: Open source simulation software “LTSpice”, Analog Devices Corporation
assessment_rules: The exam consists of an oral exam. During the oral exam, some topics included in the program will be discussed. The exam will be considered passed if the student has demonstrated having understood and assimilated the topics of the course.
bibliography: J. Millman & A. Grabel, Microelectronics, McGraw-Hill
Adel S. Sedra, K.C. Smith, Microelectronic Circuits, Oxford University Press Inc
Gray, Hurst, Lewis, Meyer, Analysis and design of Analog Integrated Circuits, John Wiley & Sons, Inc.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
